Con: It makes marriage a joke in today's western society.

I am not convinced justice systems give fair treatment to men in the case of women's false allegations, so it is better to keep no fault divorce.

First, eliminate both community property and alimony, unless the couple write a separate contract to have them. There is no good reason for the state to dictate (much less change at whim) the terms of the most important contract people make with one another. Exception: see item four.

Second, eliminate the system's pro-woman bias in both child support and child custody awards.

Third, require a paternity test before any child support award, and then limit the amount to what the state pays foster parents. And eliminate child support for women who weren't married to the baby's genetic father. (The whole original point of marriage was to be a formal agreement that he will support their offspring and she will raise them. Any woman who chooses to have and keep a child without that agreement in place should rightfully be on her own. Enacting this would eliminate the huge problem of kids being born to welfare mothers as a source of income for the mother.)

Four, continue to have no-fault divorce available, but bring back at-fault divorce too. Meaning, if one spouse caused the breakup by doing wrong to the other, whether it's battering, cheating, theft, etc. then the divorce decree should punish the spouse who misbehaved.

Five, stop having the tax laws recognize marriage at all. Tax everyone as an individual, just as if he were single.

And six, have marriage automatically dissolve when the children have all grown up and you are no longer responsible for them.

Even then, of course, I would only marry if I wanted kids.

The triplexes were used to help push trains up steep inclines and they needed a lot of traction effort to do this. Having a third set of drivers under the tender allowed it to pull itself, and push the rest of the train, instead of just trailing behind like a normal tender. It also reduced the number of locomotives needed.
